query: SELECT c.id as cardId, c.name, c.gameId, COUNT(CASE WHEN ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 END) as thisWeekCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ph.soldAt < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) THEN 1 END) as lastWeekCount, AVG(CASE WHEN ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN ph.price END) as thisWeekAvg, AVG(CASE WHEN ph.soldAt < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) THEN ph.price END) as lastWeekAvg FROM priceHistory ph INNER JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id WHERE ph.source = 'snkrdunk' AND ph.grade = 'PSA10' AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND c.gameId = 1 AND c.id NOT IN (814576, 1020570, 816129) GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.gameId HAVING thisWeekCount >= 3 AND lastWeekCount >= 3 ORDER BY (thisWeekAvg - lastWeekAvg) / lastWeekAvg DESC LIMIT 5;
